directories.constants: Contains 7 module files (assessments.js, challenges.js, index.js, observer.js)

constants/assessments.js.summary: This file defines the `ASSESSMENT_STATUSES` constant object, providing a centralized schema for tracking assessment lifecycle states throughout the project.

cache/index.js.summary: `cache/index.js` exports the `CacheManager` singleton, which handles Redis connection initialization. It serves as the project's centralized interface for managing the Redis cache client via `connect`.

constants/challenges.js.summary: This file defines configuration enums `CHALLENGE_DEPENDENCY`, `CHALLENGE_TYPE`, and `CHALLENGE_UPLOAD_TYPE`. It serves as the central source of truth for challenge-related constants used throughout the project.

constants/index.js.summary: This file acts as a central barrel export for all application constants. It aggregates and re-exports modules from the `constants/` directory to simplify imports across the project.

constants/observer.js.summary: This file defines the `OBSERVER_STATUSES` constant object, which provides standardized status codes for observer lifecycle states throughout the project.

constants/files.js.summary: This file defines the `FILE_STATUSES` constant object, providing standardized status codes for file processing operations throughout the project.

constants/progresses.js.summary: This file defines the `STATUSES` constant object, which maps progress states to numeric identifiers. It serves as the single source of truth for tracking workflow stages across the project.

db/helper.js.summary: `db/helper.js` provides `getBigIntAsNumber` to safely convert database BigInt fields into JavaScript numbers, ensuring values remain within safe integer limits for the project's data layer.

constants/stages.js.summary: This file defines the `STAGES` constant object, which maps workflow phases to numeric identifiers. It serves as the central source of truth for stage-based logic throughout the project.

db/schemas/ap_result.js.summary: This file defines the `ApResults` Sequelize model, which maps to the `ap_result` database table. It provides the `init` function to initialize the schema within the project.

db/models.js.summary: This file initializes and exports Sequelize models by aggregating various schema definitions. It serves as the central entry point for database interactions across the project.

db/index.js.summary: This file exports the `Database` singleton, which manages the PostgreSQL connection and initializes models via `connect()`. It serves as the central interface for database access across the project.
